Option Public Option Declare Use "SI_GestionErreurs" Use "x_GDK" Use "x_NAB"

Dim gns_SIAg As NotesSession Dim gndb_SIAg As NotesDatabase
Dim gndt_HeureFermeture_SIAg As NotesDateTime
Const g_ServeurDev_SIAg = "CN=Zulu/O=Serti Informatique"
' Traitement des erreurs Const gc_TypeElement_SIAg = "SL" Const gc_Element_SIAg = "SI_Agents"

Sub SIAg_DemarrerAgent(ByVal p_MaxExecution As Long, Byval p_Ajustement As Long) ' MaxExecution : Le temps maximal d'exécution. Si 0, utilise la valeur du serveur. ' Ajustement : Temps soustrait au max d'exécution s'il provient du serveur. Si 0, utilise 10 minutes. ' Pour donner du temps au dernier document d'être traité correctement. On Error Goto GererErreur
Dim v_MaxExecution As Long Dim l As Long
Call SIAg_Initialisations
If gndt_HeureFermeture_SIAg Is Nothing Then If p_MaxExecution > 0 Then v_MaxExecution = p_MaxExecution Else v_MaxExecution = xNAB_xVarServer(gndb_SIAg.Server, "MaxExecution", 0, True) l = xNAB_xVarServer(gndb_SIAg.Server, "MaxMaxExecution", 0, True) If l < v_MaxExecution Then v_MaxExecution = l End If
If p_Ajustement = 0 Then p_Ajustement = 10 End If v_MaxExecution = v_MaxExecution - p_Ajustement End If
' Calculer l'heure de fermeture de l'agent Set gndt_HeureFermeture_SIAg = New NotesDateTime(Now) Call gndt_HeureFermeture_SIAg.Adjustminute(v_MaxExecution) End If Exit Sub
GererErreur: Call SIGE_TraiterErreur(gc_TypeElement_SIAg, gc_Element_SIAg, Getthreadinfo(1), "", False) Exit Sub End Sub

Function SIAg_AgentExpire As Boolean On Error Goto GererErreur
' Vérifier si la date courante > la date d'expiration
SIAg_AgentExpire = (Now > gndt_HeureFermeture_SIAg.LSLocalTime) Exit Function
GererErreur: SIAg_AgentExpire = True Call SIGE_TraiterErreur(gc_TypeElement_SIAg, gc_Element_SIAg, Getthreadinfo(1), "", False) Exit Function End Function

Function SIAg_RelacherAmgr(p_Code As String) As Boolean On Error Goto GererErreur
SIAg_RelacherAmgr = False
Dim ns As New NotesSession Dim ndb As NotesDatabase Dim nv As NotesView Dim nd As NotesDocument
Set ndb = ns.CurrentDatabase Set nv = ndb.GetView("D_Amgr") If nv Is Nothing Then Exit Function End If
Set nd = nv.GetFirstDocument Do Until nd Is Nothing If nd.Code(0) = p_Code Then Call nd.Remove(True) SIAg_RelacherAmgr = True Exit Function End If
Set nd = nv.GetNextDocument(nd) Loop Exit Function
GererErreur: Call SIGE_TraiterErreur(gc_TypeElement_SIAg, gc_Element_SIAg, Getthreadinfo(1), "", False) Exit Function End Function

Function SIAg_EstServeurPrincipal As Boolean On Error Goto GererErreur
Dim v_ServeurPrincipal As String Dim nn As NotesName
SIAg_EstServeurPrincipal = True
' Initialisations Call SIAg_Initialisations
If gndb_SIAg.Server <> g_ServeurDev_SIAg Then v_ServeurPrincipal = xVarProf("Prof_Serveur", "") If v_ServeurPrincipal <> "" Then If v_ServeurPrincipal <> gndb_SIAg.Server Then Set nn = gns_SIAg.CreateName(xVarProf("Prof_Serveur", "")) v_ServeurPrincipal= nn.Abbreviated If v_ServeurPrincipal <> gndb_SIAg.Server Then SIAg_EstServeurPrincipal = False End If End If End If End If Exit Function
GererErreur: Call SIGE_TraiterErreur(gc_TypeElement_SIAg, gc_Element_SIAg, Getthreadinfo(1), "", False) Exit Function End Function

Sub SIAg_ExecuterAgent(p_NomUsuel As String, p_NomAgent As String, p_NoteId As String) On Error Goto GererErreur
Dim ns As New Notessession Dim ndb As Notesdatabase Dim na As Notesagent
' Vérifier que Amgr est disponible If Not SIAg_AmgrDisponible Then Print "Les agents ne sont pas autorisés pour l'instant... (" & p_NomUsuel & " : " & p_NomAgent & ")" Exit Sub End If
' Initialiser la base de documents If p_NomUsuel = "" Then Set ndb = ns.CurrentDatabase Else Set ndb = xGDK_xndbNDB(p_NomUsuel) End If If ndb Is Nothing Then Print "La base de documents " & p_NomUsuel & " est introuvable. Exécution annulée... (" & p_NomAgent & ")" Exit Sub Elseif Not ndb.Isopen Then Print "La base de documents " & p_NomUsuel & " est introuvable. Exécution annulée... (" & p_NomAgent & ")" Exit Sub End If
' Extraire l'agent Set na = ndb.GetAgent(p_NomAgent) If na Is Nothing Then Print "L'agent " & p_NomAgent & " est introuvable dans la base de documents " & p_NomUsuel & ". Exécution annulée..." Exit Sub End If
' Exécuter l'agent Print "Lancement de l'agent " & p_NomAgent & " dans la base de documents " & p_NomUsuel & "." Call na.Run(p_NoteId) Exit Sub
GererErreur: Call SIGE_TraiterErreur(gc_TypeElement_SIAg, gc_Element_SIAg, Getthreadinfo(1), p_NomUsuel & " : " & p_NomAgent, False) Exit Sub End Sub

Function SIAg_RetenirAmgr(p_Code As String) As Boolean On Error Goto GererErreur
Dim ns As New NotesSession Dim ndb As NotesDatabase Dim v As Variant Dim nd As NotesDocument
SIAg_RetenirAmgr = False Set ndb = ns.CurrentDatabase
v = Evaluate(|@Right(@Unique; 6)|) p_Code = v(0) Set nd = New NotesDocument(ndb) nd.Code = p_Code Call nd.Save(True, False) Call nd.PutInFolder("D_Amgr", True)
SIAg_RetenirAmgr = True Exit Function
GererErreur: Call SIGE_TraiterErreur(gc_TypeElement_SIAg, gc_Element_SIAg, Getthreadinfo(1), "", False) Exit Function End Function
Sub SIAg_Initialisations If gns_SIAg Is Nothing Then Set gns_SIAg = New Notessession Set gndb_SIAg = gns_SIAg.CurrentDatabase End If End Sub

Function SIAg_AmgrDisponible As Boolean On Error Goto GererErreur
Dim ns As New NotesSession Dim ndb As NotesDatabase Dim nv As NotesView Dim nd As NotesDocument
SIAg_AmgrDisponible = True
Set ndb = ns.CurrentDatabase Set nv = ndb.GetView("D_Amgr") If nv Is Nothing Then Exit Function End If
Set nd = nv.GetFirstDocument If Not (nd Is Nothing) Then SIAg_AmgrDisponible = False End If Exit Function
GererErreur: SIAg_AmgrDisponible = False Call SIGE_TraiterErreur(gc_TypeElement_SIAg, gc_Element_SIAg, Getthreadinfo(1), "", False) Exit Function End Function
Option Public Option Explicit Use "SI_Exportations" Use "SI_Extractions" Use "SI_GestionErreurs" Use "SI_Arrays"

Dim gns_A As Notessession Dim gndb_A As NotesDatabase Dim gnuiws_A As NotesUIWorkspace
Type t_Compilation Key As String NbBillet As Double NbInterv As Double DureeBillet As Double DureeInterv As Double DureeTotal As Double End Type
' Traitement des erreurs Const gc_TypeElement_Inst = "A" Const gc_Element_Inst = "A_Comp" ' Inscrire l'alias de l'agent
'@Formula à exécuter Const c_AccChars = |AccChars:=@Explode("Š,Ž,š,ž,Ÿ,À,Á,Â,Ã,Ä,Å,Ç,È,É,Ê,Ë,Ì,Í,Î,Ï,Ð,Ñ,Ò,Ó,Ô,Õ,Ö,Ù,Ú,Û,Ü,Ý,à,á,â,ã,ä,å,ç,è,é,ê,ë,ì,í,î,ï,ð,ñ,ò,ó,ô,õ,ö,ù,ú,û,ü,ý,ÿ";",");| Const c_RegChars = |RegChars:=@Explode("S,Z,s,z,Y,A,A,A,A,A,A,C,E,E,E,E,I,I,I,I,D,N,O,O,O,O,O,U,U,U,U,Y,a,a,a,a,a,a,c,e,e,e,e,i,i,i,i,d,n,o,o,o,o,o,u,u,u,u,y,y";",");| Const c_keySeparator = "~" Const c_sortSeparator = "|" Const c_keyMoment = "v_moment:=@If(@IsTime(HistoDC);HistoDC;@Modified);" Const c_keyUser = "v_user:=@ReplaceSubstring(@Name([CN];@If(Form={F_Inte};HistoUC;Bill_NomConseiller));AccChars;RegChars);" Const c_keyConseiller = "v_user" Const c_keyYearMonth = "@Text(@Year(v_moment)) + {-} + @Right({00}+@Text(@Month(v_moment));2)" Const c_selectNoConflict = "& !@IsAvailable($Conflict) " Const c_selectForm = "Form*={F_Bill}:{F_Inte} " Const c_selectHaveConseiller = "& v_user !={} " Const c_selectConseiller = "& v_user*=@Trim(" Const c_selectConseillerEnd = "{}) " Const c_selectDateFrom = " & v_moment >= @Date([" Const c_selectDateFromEnd = "])" Const c_selectDateTo = " & v_moment <= @Date([" Const c_selectDateToEnd = "])" Const c_chaineToList = "@Trim(@Explode({" Const c_chaineToListEnd = "))"
'Divers message Const c_dbTitle = "Critères de recherche pour la compilation" Const c_msgStepStartSuffixe = "..." Const c_msgStep1 = "Étape (1 de 5) - Recherche en cours " Const c_msgStep2 = "Étape (2 de 5) - Compilation en cours " Const c_msgStep3 = "Étape (3 de 3) - Trie en cours " Const c_msgStep4 = "Étape (4 de 5) - Exportation en cours " Const c_msgStep5 = "Étape (5 de 5) - Sauvegarde en cours" Const c_msgNoSelect = "Tous" Const c_msgStepEnd = "Exportation terminée!" Const c_msgNoDoc = "Aucun document ne rencontre les critères de sélection." Const c_msgCancel = "Opération annulée"
'Éléments de design ou record Const c_dbForm = "DB_Comp" Const c_dbField1 = "Parametre1" Const c_dbField2 = "Parametre2" Const c_dbField3 = "Parametre3" Const c_billFieldDureBill = "Bill_Duree" Const c_billFieldDureInte = "Inte_Dure" Const c_vueConseillerDate = "V_Bill11" Const c_vueDateConseiller = "V_Bill12" Const c_exportConseillerDate = "A_Bill11" Const c_exportDateConseiller = "A_Bill12" Const c_exportSuffixe = "Somm"

Sub Initialize On Error Goto GererErreur
' Initialisations Call A_Initialisations
' Traitement Call A_Traitement Exit Sub
GererErreur: Call SIGE_TraiterErreur(gc_TypeElement_Inst, gc_Element_Inst, GetThreadInfo(1), "", False) Exit Sub End Sub
Sub A_Initialisations If gns_A Is Nothing Then Set gns_A = New NotesSession Set gndb_A = gns_A.CurrentDatabase End If If gnuiws_A Is Nothing Then Set gnuiws_A = New NotesUIWorkspace End If End Sub

Sub A_Traitement On Error Goto GererErreur
Dim nd_DB As NotesDocument Dim nd As NotesDocument Dim ndc As NotesDocumentCollection Dim nuiv As NotesUIView Dim nv As NotesView Dim v_aColonnes As Variant Dim v_CurrentKey As Variant Dim v_arrayKey As Variant Dim v_Parametre1 As Variant Dim v_Parametre2 As String Dim v_Parametre3 As String Dim v_keyFormula As String Dim v_selectFormula As String Dim v_allKey As String Dim v_Exportation As String Dim v_printArea As String Dim v_NbLus As Double Dim v_NbALire As Double Dim v_CurrentDoc As t_Compilation Dim v_currentCompilation As t_Compilation Dim v_allCompilation List As t_Compilation
'Demander à l'utilisateur les critères de recherches Set nd_DB = New NotesDocument(gndb_A) If Not gnuiws_A.DialogBox( _ c_dbForm, True, True, False, False, False, False, c_dbTitle, nd_DB, True, False, False) Then Exit Sub End If
'Déterminer la formule permettant la recherche v_selectFormula = c_AccChars + c_RegChars + c_keyMoment + c_keyUser + c_selectForm + c_selectHaveConseiller + c_selectNoConflict v_Parametre1 = xVarArray(nd_DB,c_dbField1) If IsArray(v_Parametre1) Then v_selectFormula = v_selectFormula + c_selectConseiller ForAll a In v_Parametre1 v_selectFormula = v_selectFormula+"{"+a+"}:" End ForAll v_selectFormula = v_selectFormula + c_selectConseillerEnd End If v_Parametre2 = xVar(nd_DB, c_dbField2, "") If Not v_Parametre2 = "" Then v_selectFormula = v_selectFormula + c_selectDateFrom + v_Parametre2 + c_selectDateFromEnd End If v_Parametre3 = xVar(nd_DB, c_dbField3, "") If Not v_Parametre3 = "" Then v_selectFormula = v_selectFormula + c_selectDateTo + v_Parametre3 + c_selectDateToEnd End If
'Déterminer l'ordre de trie des documents Set nuiv = gnuiws_A.CurrentView Set nv = nuiv.View ForAll a In nv.Aliases Select Case a Case c_vueConseillerDate : v_keyFormula = c_AccChars + c_RegChars + c_keyMoment + c_keyUser +c_keyConseiller+"+{"+c_keySeparator+"}+"+c_keyYearMonth v_Exportation = c_exportConseillerDate Case c_vueDateConseiller : v_keyFormula = c_AccChars + c_RegChars + c_keyMoment + c_keyUser +c_keyYearMonth+"+{"+c_keySeparator+"}+"+c_keyConseiller v_Exportation = c_exportDateConseiller End Select End ForAll
'Rechercher les documents If v_selectFormula = "" Then Exit Sub End if Print c_msgStep1 + c_msgStepStartSuffixe Set ndc = gndb_A.Search(v_selectFormula, Nothing, 0) If ndc.Count = 0 Then MessageBox c_msgNoDoc, 16, c_msgCancel Exit Sub End If
'Cumuler les totaux dans une liste Print c_msgStep2 + c_msgStepStartSuffixe Set nd = ndc.Getfirstdocument v_NbLus = 0 v_NbALire = ndc.count Do Until nd Is Nothing v_CurrentDoc.Key = xEvaluate(v_keyFormula,nd) If xVar(nd, "Form", "") = "F_Inte" Then v_CurrentDoc.NbBillet = 0 v_CurrentDoc.NbInterv = 1 v_CurrentDoc.DureeBillet = 0 v_CurrentDoc.DureeInterv = CDbl(xVar(nd, c_billFieldDureInte, 0)) v_CurrentDoc.DureeTotal = CDbl(xVar(nd, c_billFieldDureInte, 0)) Else v_CurrentDoc.NbBillet = 1 v_CurrentDoc.NbInterv = 0 v_CurrentDoc.DureeBillet = CDbl(xVar(nd, c_billFieldDureBill, 0)) v_CurrentDoc.DureeInterv = 0 v_CurrentDoc.DureeTotal = CDbl(xVar(nd, c_billFieldDureBill, 0)) End If
If IsElement(v_allCompilation(v_CurrentDoc.Key)) = True Then v_currentCompilation = v_allCompilation(v_CurrentDoc.Key) v_currentCompilation.NbBillet = v_currentCompilation.NbBillet + v_CurrentDoc.NbBillet v_currentCompilation.NbInterv = v_currentCompilation.NbInterv + v_CurrentDoc.NbInterv v_currentCompilation.DureeBillet = v_currentCompilation.DureeBillet + v_CurrentDoc.DureeBillet v_currentCompilation.DureeInterv = v_currentCompilation.DureeInterv + v_CurrentDoc.DureeInterv v_currentCompilation.DureeTotal = v_currentCompilation.DureeTotal + v_CurrentDoc.DureeTotal v_allCompilation(v_CurrentDoc.Key) = v_currentCompilation Else v_allCompilation(v_CurrentDoc.Key) = v_CurrentDoc End if Set nd = ndc.Getnextdocument(nd) v_NbLus = v_NbLus + 1 Print c_msgStep2 + "(" & CInt(v_NbLus/v_NbALire*100) & "%)" Loop
'Trier les clef Print c_msgStep3 + c_msgStepStartSuffixe ForAll i In v_allCompilation v_allKey = v_allKey + c_sortSeparator + ListTag(i) End ForAll 'v_arrayKey = Evaluate(c_chaineToList + v_allKey+"};{" + c_sortSeparator + "}"+c_chaineToListEnd) v_arrayKey = FullTrim(Split(v_allKey,c_sortSeparator)) Call TrierArray(v_arrayKey)
'Exporter les compilations Print c_msgStep4 + c_msgStepStartSuffixe v_NbLus = 0 v_NbALire = UBound(v_arrayKey)+1 ForAll a In v_arrayKey Set nd = New NotesDocument(gndb_A) v_currentCompilation = v_allCompilation(a) v_CurrentKey = Evaluate(c_chaineToList + v_currentCompilation.Key+"};{"+c_keySeparator+"}"+c_chaineToListEnd) nd.Comp_Clef1 = v_CurrentKey(0) nd.Comp_Clef2 = v_CurrentKey(1) nd.Comp_NbBillets = v_currentCompilation.NbBillet nd.Comp_NbInterventions = v_currentCompilation.NbInterv nd.Comp_NbTotal = v_currentCompilation.NbBillet + v_currentCompilation.NbInterv nd.Comp_Duree = v_currentCompilation.DureeBillet nd.Comp_DureeInterventions = v_currentCompilation.DureeInterv nd.Comp_DureeTotal = v_currentCompilation.DureeTotal Call SIEx_ExporterDocument(nd,v_Exportation,"",xLangue, "",False, "", False)
v_NbLus = v_NbLus + 1 Print c_msgStep4 + "(" & CInt(v_NbLus/v_NbALire*100) & "%)" End ForAll
'Exporter les critères de sélection Print c_msgStep5 + c_msgStepStartSuffixe Set nd = New NotesDocument(gndb_A) If IsArray(v_Parametre1) Then nd.Comp_Conseillers = v_Parametre1 Else nd.Comp_Conseillers = c_msgNoSelect End If If v_Parametre2 + v_Parametre3 = "" Then nd.Comp_DateDe = c_msgNoSelect else nd.Comp_DateDe = v_Parametre2 nd.Comp_DateA = v_Parametre3 End If
'Mise en page v_aColonnes = xVarArray(gnd_SIEx_SIEx, "SIEx_Colonnes") If IsArray(v_aColonnes) Then v_printArea = "$A$1:$" + Chr(Asc("A")+UBound(v_aColonnes)) + "$"+CStr(g_LigneCourante_SIEx) g_ExcelApp_SIMX.ActiveSheet.PageSetup.PrintArea = v_printArea End If g_OngletCourant_SIEx = ""
Call SIEx_ExporterDocument(nd,v_Exportation+c_exportSuffixe,"",xLangue, "",False, "", False) Print c_msgStepEnd
'Libération de la mémoire des objets à référence multiples Set ndc = nothing Erase v_allCompilation
Exit Sub
GererErreur: Call SIGE_TraiterErreur(gc_TypeElement_Inst, gc_Element_Inst, GetThreadInfo(1), "", False) Exit Sub End Sub

' Déclarations globales ' ---------------------------------- Dim gns_SIEm As Notessession Dim gndb_SIEm As Notesdatabase
' Traitement des erreurs ' ----------------------------------- Const gc_TypeElement_SIEm= "SL" Const gc_Element_SIEm = "SI_Employes"

Function SIEm_MembresSDep_NoEmpl(Byval p_NoSDep As String) As Variant ' Extraire le numéro d'employé des membres des sous-départements On Error Goto GererErreur
Dim nd_SDep As NotesDocument
Call SIEm_Initialisations SIEm_MembresSDep_NoEmpl = 0
Set nd_SDep = xSIEm_xndSDep(p_NoSDep, True)
If Not nd_SDep Is Nothing Then
Select Case xVar(nd_SDep, "SDep_TypeSousDepartement", "") Case "0" : SIEm_MembresSDep_NoEmpl = Evaluate(|@Unique(@Trim(@Text(@IfError(@DbLookup(""; ""; "V_Empl36"; @Left(SDep_NoSousDepartement; 3); 2; [PARTIALMATCH]); 0))))|, nd_SDep) Case "1" : SIEm_MembresSDep_NoEmpl = Evaluate(|@Unique(@Trim(@Text(@IfError(@DbLookup(""; ""; "V_Empl36"; @Left(SDep_NoSousDepartement; 6); 2; [PARTIALMATCH]); 0))))|, nd_SDep) Case "2" : SIEm_MembresSDep_NoEmpl = Evaluate(|@Unique(@Trim(@Text(@IfError(@DbLookup(""; ""; "V_Empl36"; @Left(SDep_NoSousDepartement; 9); 2; [PARTIALMATCH]); 0))))|, nd_SDep) Case "3" : SIEm_MembresSDep_NoEmpl = Evaluate(|@Unique(@Trim(@Text(@IfError(@DbLookup(""; ""; "V_Empl36"; SDep_NoSousDepartement; 2); 0))))|, nd_SDep)
End Select
End If
Exit Function
GererErreur: Call SIGE_TraiterErreur(gc_TypeElement_SIEm, gc_Element_SIEm, Getthreadinfo(1), "", False) Exit Function End Function

Function SIEm_MembresSDep_NotesId(Byval p_NoSDep As String) As Variant ' Extraire le notes id des membres des sous-départements On Error Goto GererErreur
Dim nd_SDep As NotesDocument
Call SIEm_Initialisations SIEm_MembresSDep_NotesId = ""
Set nd_SDep = xSIEm_xndSDep(p_NoSDep, True)
If Not nd_SDep Is Nothing Then
Select Case xVar(nd_SDep, "SDep_TypeSousDepartement", "") Case "0" : SIEm_MembresSDep_NotesId = Evaluate(|@Unique(@Trim(@DbLookup(""; ""; "V_Empl36"; @Left(SDep_NoSousDepartement; 3); 3; [PARTIALMATCH] : [FAILSILENT]) : SDep_NotesIds))|, nd_SDep) Case "1" : SIEm_MembresSDep_NotesId = Evaluate(|@Unique(@Trim(@DbLookup(""; ""; "V_Empl36"; @Left(SDep_NoSousDepartement; 6); 3; [PARTIALMATCH] : [FAILSILENT]) : SDep_NotesIds))|, nd_SDep) Case "2" : SIEm_MembresSDep_NotesId = Evaluate(|@Unique(@Trim(@DbLookup(""; ""; "V_Empl36"; @Left(SDep_NoSousDepartement; 9); 3; [PARTIALMATCH] : [FAILSILENT]) : SDep_NotesIds))|, nd_SDep) Case "3" : SIEm_MembresSDep_NotesId= Evaluate(|@Unique(@Trim(@DbLookup(""; ""; "V_Empl36"; SDep_NoSousDepartement; 3 ; [FAILSILENT]) : SDep_NotesIds))|, nd_SDep) End Select
End If
Exit Function
GererErreur: Call SIGE_TraiterErreur(gc_TypeElement_SIEm, gc_Element_SIEm, Getthreadinfo(1), "", False) Exit Function End Function

code.lotusscript: Option Public Option Declare Use "SI_GestionErreurs"

Const wAPIModule = "NNOTES" ' Windows Const NSF_INFO_SIZE = 128 Const INFOPARSE_DESIGN = 3 Const NOTE_ID_ICON = &HFFFF0010
Declare Private Function DesignRefresh Lib wAPIModule Alias "DesignRefresh" _ ( Byval S As String, Byval hDB As Long, Byval F As Long, Byval zA As Long, Byval zM As Long) As Integer
Declare Private Function OSPathNetConstruct Lib wAPIModule Alias "OSPathNetConstruct" _ ( Byval zP As Long, Byval S As String, Byval F As String, Byval N As String) As Integer
Declare Private Function NSFDbInfoGet Lib wAPIModule Alias "NSFDbInfoGet" _ ( Byval hDB As Long, Byval D As String) As Integer Declare Private Sub NSFDbInfoModify Lib wAPIModule Alias "NSFDbInfoModify" _ ( Byval S As String, Byval W As Integer, Byval D As String) Declare Private Function NSFDbInfoSet Lib wAPIModule Alias "NSFDbInfoSet" _ ( Byval hDB As Long, Byval D As String) As Integer
Declare Private Function NSFDbOpen Lib wAPIModule Alias "NSFDbOpen" _ ( Byval P As String, hDB As Long) As Integer Declare Private Function NSFDbClose Lib wAPIModule Alias "NSFDbClose" _ ( Byval hDB As Long) As Integer
Declare Private Function NSFItemSetText Lib wAPIModule Alias "NSFItemSetText" _ ( Byval hNT As Long, Byval N As String, Byval D As String, Byval nD As Integer) As Integer
Declare Private Function NSFNoteOpen Lib wAPIModule Alias "NSFNoteOpen" _ ( Byval hDB As Long, Byval NoteID As Long, Byval F As Integer, hNT As Long) As Integer Declare Private Function NSFNoteClose Lib wAPIModule Alias "NSFNoteClose" _ ( Byval hNT As Long) As Integer Declare Private Function NSFNoteUpdate Lib wAPIModule Alias "NSFNoteUpdate" _ ( Byval hNT As Long, Byval F As Integer) As Integer
' Utilisé par VNDB_ChangerIDReplique Type TIMEDATE Innards(1) As Long End Type Type DBREPLICAINFO ID As TIMEDATE 'ID that is same for all replica files Flags As Integer 'Replication flags CutoffInterval As Integer 'Automatic Replication Cutoff Cutoff As TIMEDATE 'Replication cutoff date End Type Declare Function W32_NSFDbOpen Lib "nnotes.dll" Alias "NSFDbOpen" ( Byval dbName As String, hdb As Long ) As Integer Declare Function W32_NSFDbClose Lib "nnotes.dll" Alias "NSFDbClose" ( Byval hdb As Long ) As Integer Declare Function W32_NSFDbReplicaInfoGet Lib "nnotes.dll" Alias "NSFDbReplicaInfoGet" (Byval hdb As Long, hdbr As DBREPLICAINFO) As Integer Declare Function W32_NSFDbReplicaInfoSet Lib "nnotes.dll" Alias "NSFDbReplicaInfoSet" (Byval hdb As Long, hdbr As DBREPLICAINFO) As Integer
' Traitement des erreurs Const gc_TypeElement_SINDB = "SL" Const gc_Element_SINDB = "SI_NotesDatabase"

Sub SINDB_RefreshDesign(templateserver$, dbserver$, dbfilepath$) Dim dp As String dp$ = String(1024, " ") OSPathNetConstruct 0, dbserver$, dbfilepath$, dp$
Dim s As Integer Dim hDB As Long s% = NSFDbOpen(dp$, hDB) If hDB = 0 Then Exit Sub
DesignRefresh templateserver$, hDB, 1, 0, 0
NSFDbClose hDB End Sub

Sub SINDB_SetDesignTemplate(templatename$, dbserver$, dbfilepath$) Dim dp As String dp$ = String(1024, " ") OSPathNetConstruct 0, dbserver$, dbfilepath$, dp$
Dim hDB As Long NSFDbOpen dp$, hDB If hDB = 0 Then Exit Sub
Dim d As String d$ = Space(NSF_INFO_SIZE) NSFDbInfoGet hDB, d$ NSFDbInfoModify d$, INFOPARSE_DESIGN, templatename$ NSFDbInfoSet hDB, d$
NSFDbClose hDB End Sub

Function SINDB_ndGetDesignElement(pndb As NotesDatabase, p_TypeElement As String, p_NomElement As String) As NotesDocument ' PAS TESTÉ ************************************** On Error Goto GererErreur
Dim ns As New NotesSession Dim ndb As NotesDatabase Dim nnc As NotesNoteCollection Dim s As String Dim nd As NotesDocument Dim ni As NotesItem
Set ndb = ns.CurrentDatabase Set nnc = pndb.CreateNoteCollection(False) Select Case p_TypeElement Case "F": nnc.SelectForms = True Case "V": nnc.SelectViews = True Case Else Call nnc.SelectAllDesignElements(True) End Select ' nnc.SelectionFormula = |@IsMember("F_Tabl"; @GetField("$Title"))| Call nnc.BuildCollection
s = nnc.Getfirstnoteid Do Until s = "" Set nd = ndb.GetDocumentById(s) Set ni = nd.Getfirstitem("$TITLE") If ni.Contains(p_NomElement) Then Set SINDB_ndGetDesignElement = nd Exit Do End If s = nnc.Getnextnoteid(s) Loop Exit Function
GererErreur: Call SIGE_TraiterErreur(gc_TypeElement_SINDB, gc_Element_SINDB, Getthreadinfo(1), "", False) Exit Function End Function

Sub SINDB_ReplaceDesign(templateserver$, templatename$, dbserver$, dbfilepath$) Dim dp As String dp$ = String(1024, " ") OSPathNetConstruct 0, dbserver$, dbfilepath$, dp$
Dim hDB As Long NSFDbOpen dp$, hDB If hDB = 0 Then Exit Sub
Dim d As String d$ = Space(NSF_INFO_SIZE) NSFDbInfoGet hDB, d$ NSFDbInfoModify d$, INFOPARSE_DESIGN, templatename$ NSFDbInfoSet hDB, d$
Dim hNT As Long NSFNoteOpen hDB, NOTE_ID_ICON, 0, hNT NSFItemSetText hNT, "$TITLE", d$, Instr(d$, Chr$(0)) NSFNoteUpdate hNT, 0 NSFNoteClose hNT
DesignRefresh templateserver$, hDB, 1, 0, 0
NSFDbClose hDB End Sub

Function SINDB_ViderHistoriqueReplication(pndb As NotesDatabase) As Boolean On Error GoTo GererErreur
Dim nr As NotesReplication
SINDB_ViderHistoriqueReplication = False
If pndb Is Nothing Then Exit function End If
Set nr = pndb.ReplicationInfo
Call nr.ClearHistory() Call nr.Save()
SINDB_ViderHistoriqueReplication = True
Exit Function
GererErreur: Call SIGE_TraiterErreur(gc_TypeElement_SINDB, gc_Element_SINDB, GetThreadInfo(1), "", False) Exit Function End Function

Function SINDB_ChangerIDReplique(pndb As NotesDatabase) As Boolean On Error Goto GererErreur
Dim Server As String Dim FileName As String Dim Rep As String Dim ndb As NotesDatabase Dim hDb As Long Dim rc% Dim RepInfo As DBREPLICAINFO Dim var As Variant
SINDB_ChangerIDReplique = False server$ = pndb.Server filename$ = pndb.FilePath Do Set ndb = New NotesDatabase("", "") rep$ = Right("00000000" & Cstr(Clng(Today)), 8) & Right("00000000" & Cstr(Int((Now - Today) * 100000000)), 8) Loop Until Not ndb.OpenByReplicaID(server$, rep$)
If Server$ = "" Then rc% = W32_NSFDbOpen(FileName$, hDb) Else rc% = W32_NSFDbOpen(Server$ & "!!" & FileName$, hDb) End If
If rc% <> 0 Then Print "E: Base de documents introuvable : " & pndb.Title Exit Function End If rc% = W32_NSFDbReplicaInfoGet(hDb, RepInfo)
If rc% <> 0 Then Print "E: L'information de la réplique n'est pas disponible : " & pndb.Title Exit Function End If
RepInfo.ID.Innards(1) = Val( "&H"+Left$( rep$, 8 ) ) RepInfo.ID.Innards(0) = Val( "&H"+Right$( rep$, 8 ) )
rc% = W32_NSFDbReplicaInfoSet(hDb, RepInfo) ' take a deep breath... :-)
rc% = W32_NSFDbReplicaInfoGet(hDb, RepInfo) If rc% <> 0 Then Print "*** Impossible de vérifier si le nouvel ID de réplique a été modifié correctement : " & pndb.Title Else Print "Le nouvel ID de réplique de la base de documents « " & pndb.Title & " » est " & Right("0000000" + Hex(RepInfo.ID.Innards(1)), 8) + ":" + Right("0000000" + Hex(RepInfo.ID.Innards(0)), 8) End If
rc% = W32_NSFDbClose(hDb) SINDB_ChangerIDReplique = True Exit Function
GererErreur: Call SIGE_TraiterErreur(gc_TypeElement_SINDB, gc_Element_SINDB, Getthreadinfo(1), "", False) Exit Function End Function

Sub SDSSI_Initialisations If gns_SDSSI Is Nothing Then Set gns_SDSSI = New NotesSession Set gndb_SDSSI = gns_SDSSI.CurrentDatabase
Set gndb_SDSS_SDSSI = xGDK_xndbNDB("SDS Soutien") If gndb_SDSS_SDSSI Is Nothing Then Messagebox "La base de documents SDS Soutien est introuvable.", 16, "Opération annulée" End Elseif Not gndb_SDSS_SDSSI.IsOpen Then Messagebox "La base de documents SDS Soutien est introuvable.", 16, "Opération annulée" End End If End If End Sub

Function SDSSI_AffecterConseiller(p_Clients As Variant) As Boolean On Error Goto GererErreur
Dim nv As NotesView Dim ndc As NotesDocumentCollection Dim nuiws As New NotesUIWorkspace Dim nd_DB As NotesDocument
Dim nd As NotesDocument
' Initialisations SDSSI_AffecterConseiller = False Call SDSSI_Initialisations
Select Case Lcase(Typename(p_Clients)) Case "notesdocumentcollection": Set ndc = p_Clients Case "notesdocument": Set nv = gndb_SDSSI.GetView("V_AdmT") Set ndc = nv.GetAllDocumentsByKey("*BiDoN*", True) Call ndc.AddDocument(p_Clients) Case Else: End End Select
' Demander les paramètres de l'inventaire à l'utilisateur Set nd_DB = New NotesDocument(gndb_SDSSI) If Not nuiws.DialogBox( "DB_InvA" , True , True , False , False , False , False , "Affecter un conseiller" , nd_DB, True, False, False) Then Exit Function End If
Call ndc.StampAll("Inve_NoEmploye", xVar(nd_DB, "Inve_NoEmploye", "")) Call ndc.StampAll("Inve_NomEmploye", xSIEm_xVarEmpl(xVar(nd_DB, "Inve_NoEmploye", ""), _ "Empl_NomEmploye", "", True)) Call ndc.StampAll("Inve_NoCellulaire", xVar(nd_DB, "Inve_NoCellulaire", ""))
SDSSI_AffecterConseiller = True Exit Function
GererErreur: Call SIGE_TraiterErreur(gc_TypeElement_SDSSI, gc_Element_SDSSI, Getthreadinfo(1), "", False) Exit Function End Function

Sub Querysave(Source As Notesuidocument, Continue As Variant) If gnsSFH Is Nothing Then Set gnsSFH = New Notessession End If
' Mise à jour de l'historique If Source.Isnewdoc Then Source.Document.HistoDC = Now Source.Document.HistoUC = gnsSFH.UserName Source.Document.HistoDM = "" Source.Document.HistoUM = "" Else If Source.Document.HistoDC(0) = "" Then Source.Document.HistoDC = Source.Document.Created End If Source.Document.HistoDM = Now Source.Document.HistoUM = gnsSFH.UserName End If End Sub
Option Public Option Declare Use "SDSS_DossierBillets" Use "SI_AgentsTravaux" '<EB> Use "SI_CourrielsTypes" Use "PJ_Contacts" Use "x_Tabl" Use "x_SIRq" '<EB>

' Déclarations globales ' ---------------------------------- Dim gns_SDSSB As Notessession Dim gndb_SDSSB As NotesDatabase
' Traitement des erreurs ' ------------------------------- Const gc_TypeElement_SDSSB = "SL" Const gc_Element_SDSSB = "SDSS_Billet"

Function SDSSB_AjouterDansDossiersGroupe(pnd_Bill As NotesDocument, pa_NoEmpMembresGroupe As Variant) As Boolean '----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- ' Le script permet d'ajouter le billet dans les dossiers des membres du groupe 'Paramètre: ' pnd : NotesDocument. Le billet sélectionné . '----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- On Error Goto GererErreur
Dim v_NomGroupeAffecter As String Dim v_NomGroupeAffecterIntial As String Dim v_AliasVue As String Dim v_Parametres As Variant
' Initialisations '------------------- Call SDSSDB_Initialisations Call xSIEm_Initialisation
v_NomGroupeAffecter = xVar(pnd_Bill,"Bill_NomGroupeAffecter","") v_NomGroupeAffecterIntial = xVar(pnd_Bill,"Bill_NomGroupeAffecterInitial","")
SDSSB_AjouterDansDossiersGroupe = False
If v_NomGroupeAffecter = "" Or _ v_NomGroupeAffecter = v_NomGroupeAffecterIntial Then Exit Function End If
If Isarray(pa_NoEmpMembresGroupe) Then
' Ne pas retourner de message d'erreur si groupe membres vide If pa_NoEmpMembresGroupe(Lbound(pa_NoEmpMembresGroupe)) = "" Then SDSSB_AjouterDansDossiersGroupe = True Exit Function End If
If pa_NoEmpMembresGroupe(Lbound(pa_NoEmpMembresGroupe)) <> "" Then ' Retirer le billet des anciens dossiers Forall EmpNo In pa_NoEmpMembresGroupe
If Cstr(EmpNo) <> Cstr(xVar(pnd_Bill, "Bill_NoPersAffecterInitial", 0)) Then If Not SDSSDB_AjouterDansDossier(pnd_Bill, Cstr(EmpNo), "A") Then
Call SDSSDB_InfoDossier(Cstr(EmpNo), "A" , "", v_AliasVue, "") v_Parametres = Evaluate(|"| & xVar(pnd_Bill, "Bill_NoBillet", "") & |":"| & v_AliasVue & |"|)
Messagebox xGDK_xMessage("SDSS", 28, "", v_Parametres), 48, xGDK_xMessage("SDSS", 27, "", "") Call SIGE_TraiterErreurManuelle(gc_TypeElement_SDSSB, gc_Element_SDSSB, Getthreadinfo(1), 0, _ xGDK_xMessage("SDSS", 28, "", v_Parametres), "", True)
SDSSB_AjouterDansDossiersGroupe= False
'Exit Function Else SDSSB_AjouterDansDossiersGroupe = True End If Else SDSSB_AjouterDansDossiersGroupe = True End If
End Forall End If
End If
Exit Function
GererErreur: Call SIGE_TraiterErreur(gc_TypeElement_SDSSB, gc_Element_SDSSB, Getthreadinfo(1), "", False) Exit Function End Function

Function SDSSB_AffecterGroupe(pnd_Bill As NotesDocument, p_NomGroupeAffecter As String, p_CodeGroupeAffecter As String, p_Commentaire As String) As Boolean On Error Goto GererErreur On Error 4294 Resume Next ' Unable to send mail, no match found in Name & Address Book(s)
Dim nd As NotesDocument Dim nrti As NotesRichTextItem Dim v_SendTo As String Dim v_NomPersAffecterInitial As String Dim v_Commentaire As String Dim v_NoBillet As String Dim v_Interventions As String Dim v_MembresSDep As Variant
SDSSB_AffecterGroupe = False
' Vérifier si le suivi va changer ' --------------------------------------- If p_NomGroupeAffecter = "" Or p_NomGroupeAffecter = xVar(pnd_Bill, "Bill_NomGroupeAffecter", "") Then Exit Function End If
' Initialisations Call SDSSB_Initialisations Call xSIEm_Initialisation
v_NomPersAffecterInitial = Cstr( xSIEm_xVarEmpl(xVar(pnd_Bill, "Bill_NoPersAffecterInitial",0), "Empl_NomEmploye", "", True))
' Assigner commentaire If xVar(pnd_Bill, "Bill_NomGroupeAffecter", "") = "" Then
If v_NomPersAffecterInitial <> "" Then v_Commentaire = "Action nouvelle affectation : " & v_NomPersAffecterInitial & " --> " & p_CodeGroupeAffecter Else v_Commentaire = "Action nouvelle affectation : " & p_CodeGroupeAffecter End If Else v_Commentaire = "Action nouvelle affectation : " & xVar(pnd_Bill, "Bill_CodeGroupeAffecter", "") & " --> " & p_CodeGroupeAffecter End If If p_Commentaire <> "" Then v_Commentaire = v_Commentaire & Chr(13) & p_Commentaire End If
' Assigner le affectation ' ----------------------- pnd_Bill.Bill_NomGroupeAffecterInitial = xVar(pnd_Bill, "Bill_NomGroupeAffecter", "") pnd_Bill.Bill_NomGroupeAffecter = p_NomGroupeAffecter pnd_Bill.Bill_CodeGroupeAffecter = p_CodeGroupeAffecter pnd_Bill.Bill_NoPersAffecter= "" pnd_Bill.Bill_NomPersAffecter= "" ' RQ 35459 Nveaux champs: Bill_NoSousDepartementAffecter, Bill_DescSousDepartementAffecter pnd_Bill.Bill_NoSousDepartementAffecter = "" pnd_Bill.Bill_DescSousDepartementAffecter = ""
If Not SIHi_Ajouter(pnd_Bill, "", v_Commentaire, "", False) Then Exit Function End If
' Accepter le billet If SIHi_BatirHistorique(pnd_Bill) Then
' Envoyer le courriel au groupe concerné v_MembresSDep = SIEm_MembresSDep_NotesId(p_NomGroupeAffecter)
If Isarray(v_MembresSDep) Then If v_MembresSDep(Lbound(v_MembresSDep)) <> "" Then If Left(Lcase(p_NomGroupeAffecter), 2) <> "sd" Then v_SendTo = "sd" & p_NomGroupeAffecter End If Else v_SendTo = p_NomGroupeAffecter End If Else v_SendTo = p_NomGroupeAffecter End If
If v_SendTo <> "" Then pnd_BIll.Bill_StatutCommentaires = p_Commentaire
' Construire le message Set nd = SICT_ConstruireMessage(pnd_Bill, "A_WFBi_NaGrou","FR", v_SendTo, "", "", False, "") If Not (nd Is Nothing) Then ' Ajouter les n dernières interventions (ici n = 2 ) v_NoBillet = xVar(pnd_Bill, "Bill_NoBillet", "") v_Interventions = SDSSB_ExtraireInterventions(v_NoBillet, 2) Set nrti = nd.GetFirstItem("Body") Call SItRT_Remplacer(nrti, "[interventions]", v_Interventions)
' Envoyer le message If Instr(Lcase(gndb_SDSSB.Server), "zulu") > 0 Then ' Serveur de développement nd.SendTo = gns_SDSSB.UserName nd.CopyTo = "" Call nd.Send(False) Else Call nd.Send(False) End If
End If End If
SDSSB_AffecterGroupe = True End If
Exit Function
GererErreur: Call SIGE_TraiterErreur(gc_TypeElement_SDSSB, gc_Element_SDSSB, Getthreadinfo(1), "", False) Exit Function End Function

Function SDSSB_TransfertDossierAffecterGroupe(pnd_Bill As NotesDocument) As Boolean '------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- 'Le script permet de transferer le billet d'un groupe à l'autre '------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- On Error Goto GererErreur
Dim nv_Grou40 As notesview Dim v_NomGroupeAffecter As String Dim v_NomGroupeAffecterIntial As String Dim v_NoEmpMembresGroupe As Variant Dim v_NoEmpMembresGroupeInitial As Variant Dim nd_GrouAffecterInitial As NotesDocument Dim nd_GrouAffecter As NotesDocument Dim a_NoEmpMembresGroupe As Variant Dim a_NoEmpMembresGroupeInitial As Variant Dim v_NoPersAffecterIntial As Integer Dim v_AliasVue As String Dim v_Parametres As Variant Dim v_Maj As Boolean
SDSSB_TransfertDossierAffecterGroupe = False
' Initialisations '------------------- Call xSIEm_Initialisation
Set nv_Grou40 = gndb_xSIEm.GetView("V_Grou40")
v_NomGroupeAffecter = xVar(pnd_Bill,"Bill_NomGroupeAffecter","") v_NomGroupeAffecterIntial = xVar(pnd_Bill,"Bill_NomGroupeAffecterInitial","") v_NoPersAffecterIntial = xVar(pnd_Bill,"Bill_NoPersAffecterInitial",0)
If v_NomGroupeAffecter = v_NomGroupeAffecterIntial Then SDSSB_TransfertDossierAffecterGroupe = True Exit Function End If
Set nd_GrouAffecterInitial = nv_Grou40.GetdocumentByKey(v_NomGroupeAffecterIntial, True) If Not nd_GrouAffecterInitial Is Nothing Then a_NoEmpMembresGroupeInitial = SDSSDB_ExtraireMembresGroupe(nd_GrouAffecterInitial, v_NomGroupeAffecterIntial) End If
Set nd_GrouAffecter = nv_Grou40.GetdocumentByKey(v_NomGroupeAffecter, True) If Not nd_GrouAffecter Is Nothing Then a_NoEmpMembresGroupe = SDSSDB_ExtraireMembresGroupe(nd_GrouAffecter, v_NomGroupeAffecter) End If
If v_NomGroupeAffecter <> v_NomGroupeAffecterIntial Then
'Transfert de groupe à nouvelle groupe If v_NomGroupeAffecter <> "" And v_NomGroupeAffecterIntial <> "" Then If Not SDSSB_TransfertDeDossierGroupe(pnd_Bill) Then SDSSB_TransfertDossierAffecterGroupe = False Exit Function End If End If
'Retirer du groupe (transfer à null) If v_NomGroupeAffecter = "" And v_NomGroupeAffecterIntial <> "" Then
If Not SDSSB_RetirerDeDossiersGroupe(pnd_Bill, "", a_NoEmpMembresGroupeInitial) Then SDSSB_TransfertDossierAffecterGroupe = False Exit Function End If End If
'Ajouter dans dossiers du groupe (transfer de null à groupe) If v_NomGroupeAffecter <> "" And v_NomGroupeAffecterIntial = "" Then If Isarray(a_NoEmpMembresGroupe) Then If Not SDSSB_AjouterDansDossiersGroupe(pnd_Bill, a_NoEmpMembresGroupe) Then SDSSB_TransfertDossierAffecterGroupe = False Exit Function End If End If End If
v_Maj = True End If
' Retirer le document du dossier de l'employé(si transfert de employé vers groupe) If v_NoPersAffecterIntial <> 0 Then
If Isnull(Arraygetindex(a_NoEmpMembresGroupe, Cstr(v_NoPersAffecterIntial))) Then If Not SDSSDB_RetirerDuDossier(pnd_Bill, Cstr(v_NoPersAffecterIntial) ,"A") Then
Call SDSSDB_InfoDossier(Cstr(v_NoPersAffecterIntial),"A" , "", v_AliasVue, "") v_Parametres = Evaluate(|"| & xVar(pnd_Bill, "Bill_NoBillet", "") & |":"| & v_AliasVue & |"|)
Messagebox xGDK_xMessage("SDSS", 26, "", v_Parametres), 48, xGDK_xMessage("SDSS", 18, "", "") Call SIGE_TraiterErreurManuelle(gc_TypeElement_SDSSB, gc_Element_SDSSB, Getthreadinfo(1), 0, _ xGDK_xMessage("SDSS", 26, "", v_Parametres), "", True) 'Error 4005, xGDK_xMessage("SDSS", 26, "", v_Parametres)
SDSSB_TransfertDossierAffecterGroupe = False Exit Function End If End If
v_Maj = True End If
If v_Maj = True Then pnd_Bill.Bill_NoPersAffecterInitial = 0 pnd_Bill.Bill_NoPersAffecter = 0 pnd_Bill.Bill_NomGroupeAffecterInitial= v_NomGroupeAffecter Call pnd_Bill.Save(True,False) End If
SDSSB_TransfertDossierAffecterGroupe = True
Exit Function
GererErreur: Call SIGE_TraiterErreur(gc_TypeElement_SDSSB, gc_Element_SDSSB, Getthreadinfo(1), "", False) Exit Function End Function

Function SDSSB_TransfertDeDossierGroupe(pnd_Bill As NotesDocument) As Boolean '------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- ' Le script permet de transferer le billet ' pnd : NotesDocument. Le billet sélectionné . '------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- On Error Goto GererErreur
Dim v_NomGroupeAffecter As String Dim v_NomGroupeAffecterIntial As String Dim nv_Grou40 As notesview Dim a_NoEmpMembresGroupe As Variant Dim a_NoEmpMembresGroupeInitial As Variant Dim nd_GrouAffecter As NotesDocument
SDSSB_TransfertDeDossierGroupe = False
' Initialisations
Call xSIEm_Initialisation
v_NomGroupeAffecter = xVar(pnd_Bill,"Bill_NomGroupeAffecter","") v_NomGroupeAffecterIntial = xVar(pnd_Bill,"Bill_NomGroupeAffecterInitial","")
Set nv_Grou40 = gndb_xSIEm.GetView("V_Grou40")
If Not nv_Grou40 Is Nothing Then
Set nd_GrouAffecter = nv_Grou40.GetdocumentByKey(v_NomGroupeAffecter, True)
If Not nd_GrouAffecter Is Nothing Then a_NoEmpMembresGroupe = SDSSDB_ExtraireMembresGroupe(nd_GrouAffecter, v_NomGroupeAffecter)
'Transfert le billet If Isarray(a_NoEmpMembresGroupe) Then If a_NoEmpMembresGroupe(Lbound(a_NoEmpMembresGroupe)) <> "" Then If SDSSB_AjouterDansDossiersGroupe(pnd_Bill, a_NoEmpMembresGroupe) Then Set nd_GrouAffecter = nv_Grou40.GetdocumentByKey(v_NomGroupeAffecterIntial, True) If Not nd_GrouAffecter Is Nothing Then a_NoEmpMembresGroupeInitial = SDSSDB_ExtraireMembresGroupe(nd_GrouAffecter, v_NomGroupeAffecterIntial) If SDSSB_RetirerDeDossiersGroupe(pnd_Bill, a_NoEmpMembresGroupe, a_NoEmpMembresGroupeInitial) Then SDSSB_TransfertDeDossierGroupe = True End If End If End If Else
Set nd_GrouAffecter = nv_Grou40.GetdocumentByKey(v_NomGroupeAffecterIntial, True) If Not nd_GrouAffecter Is Nothing Then a_NoEmpMembresGroupeInitial = SDSSDB_ExtraireMembresGroupe(nd_GrouAffecter, v_NomGroupeAffecterIntial) If SDSSB_RetirerDeDossiersGroupe(pnd_Bill, a_NoEmpMembresGroupe, a_NoEmpMembresGroupeInitial) Then SDSSB_TransfertDeDossierGroupe = True Exit Function End If End If
SDSSB_TransfertDeDossierGroupe = True Exit Function End If Else SDSSB_TransfertDeDossierGroupe = True Exit Function End If
End If
End If
Exit Function
GererErreur: Call SIGE_TraiterErreur(gc_TypeElement_SDSSB, gc_Element_SDSSB, Getthreadinfo(1), "", False) Exit Function End Function

Function SDSSB_ExtraireInterventions(p_NoBillet As String, p_NbInterventions As Integer) As String '------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- ' Le script permet d'extraire les n dernièrs interventions d'un billet ' ' Paramètres : p_NoBillet: numéro du billet ' p_NbInterventions: nombre d'interventions à extraire '------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- On Error Goto GererErreur
Dim nv As NotesView Dim nd As NotesDocument Dim nd_Suivant As NotesDocument Dim v_Date As String Dim v_Auteur As Variant Dim v_Texte As String Dim v_NoIntervention As Integer Dim v_DescIntervention As String
SDSSB_ExtraireInterventions = "aucunes"
Set nv = gndb_SDSSB.Getview("V_Inte20") ' Extraire la 1ère intervention du billet Set nd_Suivant = nv.Getdocumentbykey(Clng(p_NoBillet), True) Do Until nd_Suivant Is Nothing Set nd = nd_Suivant ' Extraire l'intervention suivante Set nd_Suivant = nv.Getnextdocument(nd_Suivant) ' Si le numéro de billet a changé If xVar(nd_Suivant, "Bill_NoBillet", "") <> p_NoBillet Then ' Ne pas traiter l'intervention suivante Set nd_Suivant = Nothing End If ' Traiter l'affichage de l'intervention dans le courriel v_Date = Format$(xVar(nd, "HistoDC", ""), "yyyy-mm-dd") v_Auteur = Evaluate( |@Name([CN]; "| & xVar(nd, "HistoUC", "") & |")|) v_Texte = xVar(nd, "Inte_Sommaire", "") v_DescIntervention = v_Date & " - " & v_Auteur(0) & Chr(13) & v_Texte If v_NoIntervention = 0 Then SDSSB_ExtraireInterventions = v_DescIntervention Else SDSSB_ExtraireInterventions = SDSSB_ExtraireInterventions & Chr(13) & Chr(13) & v_DescIntervention End If
v_NoIntervention = v_NoIntervention + 1 ' Si le nombre d'intervention est atteint If v_NoIntervention >= p_NbInterventions Then ' Ne pas traiter l'intervention suivante Set nd_Suivant = Nothing End If Loop
Exit Function
GererErreur: Call SIGE_TraiterErreur(gc_TypeElement_SDSSB, gc_Element_SDSSB, Getthreadinfo(1), p_NoBillet, False) Exit Function End Function

Function SDSSB_TransfertDeDossierEmploye(pnd_Bill As NotesDocument, p_NoEmploye As Integer, p_NoEmployeInitial As Integer, p_Type As String) As Boolean '------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- ' Le script permet de transferer le billet ' pnd : NotesDocument. Le billet sélectionné . ' p_Type : String. Le type de dossier ( C = conseiller , A = affectation) '------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- On Error Goto GererErreur
Dim v_AliasVue As String Dim v_Parametres As Variant
SDSSB_TransfertDeDossierEmploye = False
Call SDSSDB_InfoDossier(Cstr(p_NoEmploye), p_Type , "", v_AliasVue, "") v_Parametres = Evaluate(|"| & xVar(pnd_Bill, "Bill_NoBillet", "") & |":"| & v_AliasVue & |"|)
'Transfert le billet If SDSSDB_AjouterDansDossier(pnd_Bill, Cstr(p_NoEmploye), p_Type) Then SDSSB_TransfertDeDossierEmploye = True If p_NoEmployeInitial <> 0 Then If Not SDSSDB_RetirerDuDossier(pnd_Bill, Cstr(p_NoEmployeInitial), p_Type) Then
Messagebox xGDK_xMessage("SDSS", 26, "", v_Parametres), 48, xGDK_xMessage("SDSS", 18, "", "") Call SIGE_TraiterErreurManuelle(gc_TypeElement_SDSSB, gc_Element_SDSSB, Getthreadinfo(1), 0, _ xGDK_xMessage("SDSS", 26, "", v_Parametres), "", True)

Else Messagebox xGDK_xMessage("SDSS", 28, "", v_Parametres), 48, xGDK_xMessage("SDSS", 27, "", "") Call SIGE_TraiterErreurManuelle(gc_TypeElement_SDSSB, gc_Element_SDSSB, Getthreadinfo(1), 0, _ xGDK_xMessage("SDSS", 28, "", v_Parametres), "", True) End If

GererErreur: Call SIGE_TraiterErreur(gc_TypeElement_SDSSB, gc_Element_SDSSB, Getthreadinfo(1), "", False) Exit Function End Function

Function SDSSB_Brouillon(pnd_Bill As notesdocument) As Boolean '------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------ ' 'Valider si les champs obligatoire sont remplis, si non le document reste brouillon '------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------ On Error Goto GererErreur
' Initialisations Call SDSSB_Initialisations
Dim v_BillChampsBrouillon(4) As String Dim i As Integer Dim v_SousType As Variant
SDSSB_Brouillon = True v_SousType = Evaluate(|@IfError(@DbLookup("" : "NoCache"; "" : ""; "V_Tabl20"; "| & "Bill_SousType;" & xVar(pnd_Bill, "Bill_Type", "") & |"; 4);"")|)
v_BillChampsBrouillon(0) = xVar(pnd_Bill, "Bill_ClientNo1", "") v_BillChampsBrouillon(1) =xVar(pnd_Bill, "Bill_DescSommaire", "") v_BillChampsBrouillon(2) =xVar(pnd_Bill, "Bill_Type", "")
If v_BillChampsBrouillon(2) <> "" Then If xVar(pnd_Bill, "Bill_SousType", "") = "" Then If Isarray(v_SousType) And v_SousType(0) <> "" Then v_BillChampsBrouillon(3) =xVar(pnd_Bill, "Bill_SousType", "") Else v_BillChampsBrouillon(3) = "<non obligatoire>" End If Else v_BillChampsBrouillon(3) = "<non obligatoire>" End If Else v_BillChampsBrouillon(3) =xVar(pnd_Bill, "Bill_SousType", "") End If
v_BillChampsBrouillon(4) =xVar(pnd_Bill, "Bill_Media", "")
For i= Lbound(v_BillChampsBrouillon) To Ubound(v_BillChampsBrouillon) If v_BillChampsBrouillon(i) = "" Then Exit Function End If Next
SDSSB_Brouillon= False
Exit Function
GererErreur: Call SIGE_TraiterErreur(gc_TypeElement_SDSSB, gc_Element_SDSSB, Getthreadinfo(1), "", False) Exit Function End Function

Function SDSSB_AffecterEmploye(pnd_Bill As NotesDocument, p_NomPersAffecter As String, p_NoPersAffecter As Integer, _ p_Commentaire As String) As Boolean On Error Goto GererErreur
Dim nd As NotesDocument Dim nrti As NotesRichTextItem
Dim v_CodeGroupeAffecter As String Dim v_Commentaire As String Dim v_DatabaseSIEm As String Dim v_Formule As String Dim v_Interventions As String Dim v_NoBillet As String Dim v_NoSousDepartement As Variant Dim v_NomPersAffecterInitial As String Dim v_NomGroupeAffecterInitial As String Dim v_SendTo As String
SDSSB_AffecterEmploye = False
' Vérifier si le suivi va changer ' -------------------------------- If p_NomPersAffecter = "" Or p_NomPersAffecter = xVar(pnd_Bill, "Bill_NomPersAffecter", "") Or _ p_NoPersAffecter = 0 Or p_NoPersAffecter = xVar(pnd_Bill, "Bill_NoPersAffecter", 0)Then Exit Function End If
' Initialisations Call SDSSB_Initialisations Call xSIEm_Initialisation
v_DatabaseSIEm = Replace(|"| & gndb_xSIEm.Server & |":"| & gndb_xSIEm.FilePath & |"|, "\", "\\")
v_NomPersAffecterInitial = Cstr( xSIEm_xVarEmpl(xVar(pnd_Bill, "Bill_NoPersAffecterInitial",0), "Empl_NomEmploye", "", True)) v_NomGroupeAffecterInitial = xVar(pnd_Bill, "Bill_NomGroupeAffecterInitial","") v_CodeGroupeAffecter = xVar(pnd_Bill, "Bill_CodeGroupeAffecter","")
' Assigner commentaire If xVar(pnd_Bill, "Bill_NomPersAffecter", "") = "" Then
If v_NomGroupeAffecterInitial <> "" Then v_Commentaire = "Action nouvelle affectation : " & v_CodeGroupeAffecter & " --> " & p_NomPersAffecter Else v_Commentaire = "Action nouvelle affectation : " & p_NomPersAffecter End If Else
If v_NomGroupeAffecterInitial <> "" Then v_Commentaire = "Action nouvelle affectation : " & v_CodeGroupeAffecter & " --> " & p_NomPersAffecter Else v_Commentaire = "Action nouvelle affectation : " & xVar(pnd_Bill, "Bill_NomPersAffecter", "") & " --> " & p_NomPersAffecter End If
End If If p_Commentaire <> "" Then v_Commentaire = v_Commentaire & Chr(13) & p_Commentaire End If
' Assigner l'affectation ' ---------------------- pnd_Bill.Bill_NoPersAffecterInitial = xVar(pnd_Bill, "Bill_NoPersAffecter", 0) pnd_Bill.Bill_NoPersAffecter= p_NoPersAffecter pnd_Bill.Bill_NomPersAffecter= p_NomPersAffecter
' RQ 35459 Nveaux champs: Bill_NoSousDepartementAffecter (multi-valeurs), Bill_DescSousDepartementAffecter (multi-valeurs) v_NoSousDepartement = xSIEm_xVarEmpl(p_NoPersAffecter, "Empl_NoSousDepartement", "", True) If Isarray(v_NoSousDepartement) Then ' Si l'employé a plusieurs sous-départements v_Formule = |@IfError(@DbLookup(""; | & v_DatabaseSIEm & |; "V_SDep20"; "| & Implode(v_NoSousDepartement, |":"|) & |"; 2); "")| pnd_Bill.Bill_DescSousDepartementAffecter = Evaluate(v_Formule) pnd_Bill.Bill_NoSousDepartementAffecter = v_NoSousDepartement Elseif v_NoSousDepartement <> "" Then pnd_Bill.Bill_DescSousDepartementAffecter = xSIEm_xVarSDep(v_NoSousDepartement, "SDep_NomSousDepartementFR", "", True) pnd_Bill.Bill_NoSousDepartementAffecter = v_NoSousDepartement Else pnd_Bill.Bill_DescSousDepartementAffecter = "" pnd_Bill.Bill_NoSousDepartementAffecter = "" End If
pnd_Bill.Bill_NomGroupeAffecter = "" pnd_Bill.Bill_CodeGroupeAffecter = ""
If Not SIHi_Ajouter(pnd_Bill, "", v_Commentaire, "", False) Then Exit Function End If
' Accepter le billet If SIHi_BatirHistorique(pnd_Bill) Then
' Envoyer le courriel aux personnes concernées v_SendTo = Cstr( xSIEm_xVarEmpl(p_NoPersAffecter, "Empl_NotesId", 0, True)) If v_SendTo <> "" Then pnd_BIll.Bill_StatutCommentaires = p_Commentaire
' Construire le message Set nd = SICT_ConstruireMessage(pnd_Bill, "A_WFBi_NaEmpl","FR", v_SendTo, "", "", False, "") If Not (nd Is Nothing) Then ' Ajouter les n dernières interventions (ici n = 2 ) v_NoBillet = xVar(pnd_Bill, "Bill_NoBillet", "") v_Interventions = SDSSB_ExtraireInterventions(v_NoBillet, 2) Set nrti = nd.GetFirstItem("Body") Call SItRT_Remplacer(nrti, "[interventions]", v_Interventions)
' Envoyer le message If Instr(Lcase(gndb_SDSSB.Server), "zulu") > 0 Then ' Serveur de développement nd.SendTo = gns_SDSSB.UserName nd.CopyTo = "" Call nd.Send(False) Else Call nd.Send(False) End If
End If End If
SDSSB_AffecterEmploye = True End If
Exit Function
GererErreur: Call SIGE_TraiterErreur(gc_TypeElement_SDSSB, gc_Element_SDSSB, Getthreadinfo(1), "", False) Exit Function End Function

Function SDSSB_MajDossierMesSuivis(pnd_Bill As NotesDocument) As Boolean '------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- ' Le script permet d'ajouter ou retirer le billet dans le dossier de suivi de l'employé '------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- On Error Goto GererErreur
Dim ni_Bill_MesSuivi As NotesItem Dim ni_Bill_MesSuiviID As NotesItem Dim v_BillMesSuiviID As Variant Dim v_BillMesSuivi As Variant Dim v_NoEmploye As String
SDSSB_MajDossierMesSuivis = False

Set ni_Bill_MesSuiviID = pnd_Bill.GetFirstItem("Bill_MesSuiviID") v_NoEmploye = xSIEm_xVarEmpl_ID(gns_SDSSB.Username, "Empl_NoEmploye", "", True)
If ni_Bill_MesSuiviID.Contains(gns_SDSSB.Username) Then 'Ajouter le dans dossier If SDSSDB_AjouterDansDossier(pnd_Bill, v_NoEmploye, "S") Then SDSSB_MajDossierMesSuivis = True Exit Function End If Else 'Retirer du dossier If SDSSDB_RetirerDuDossier(pnd_Bill, v_NoEmploye, "S") Then SDSSB_MajDossierMesSuivis = True Exit Function End If End If

Function SDSSB_TransfertDossierAffecterEmploye(pnd_Bill As NotesDocument) As Boolean '------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- 'Le script permet de transferer le billet a l'employé en affectation. '------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- On Error Goto GererErreur
Dim v_NoPersAffecter As Integer Dim v_NoPersAffecterIntial As Integer Dim v_NomGroupeAffecterIntial As String Dim nd_GrouAffecter As Notesdocument Dim nd_GrouAffecterInitial As NotesDocument Dim a_NoEmpMembresGroupeInitial As Variant Dim v_NoEmpMembresGroupeInitial As Variant Dim nv_Grou40 As notesview Dim v_AliasVue As String Dim v_Parametres As Variant Dim v_Maj As Boolean
SDSSB_TransfertDossierAffecterEmploye = False
' Initialisations '------------------- Call xSIEm_Initialisation
Set nv_Grou40 = gndb_xSIEm.GetView("V_Grou40")
'Maj des dossiers du affecter à si le affecter à a changé. v_NoPersAffecter = xVar(pnd_Bill,"Bill_NoPersAffecter",0) v_NoPersAffecterIntial = xVar(pnd_Bill,"Bill_NoPersAffecterInitial",0) v_NomGroupeAffecterIntial = xVar(pnd_Bill,"Bill_NomGroupeAffecterInitial","")
If v_NoPersAffecter = v_NoPersAffecterIntial Then SDSSB_TransfertDossierAffecterEmploye = True Exit Function End If
If v_NomGroupeAffecterIntial <> "" Then Set nd_GrouAffecterInitial = nv_Grou40.GetdocumentByKey(v_NomGroupeAffecterIntial, True) If Not nd_GrouAffecterInitial Is Nothing Then a_NoEmpMembresGroupeInitial = SDSSDB_ExtraireMembresGroupe(nd_GrouAffecterInitial, v_NomGroupeAffecterIntial) End If End If
If v_NoPersAffecter <> v_NoPersAffecterIntial Then
'Transfert d'un employé à l'autre If v_NoPersAffecter <> 0 And v_NoPersAffecterIntial <> 0 Then If Not SDSSB_TransfertDeDossierEmploye(pnd_Bill, v_NoPersAffecter, v_NoPersAffecterIntial, "A") Then SDSSB_TransfertDossierAffecterEmploye = False Exit Function End If End If
'Retirer du dossier de l'employé (transfer à null) If v_NoPersAffecter = 0 And v_NoPersAffecterIntial <> 0 Then If Not SDSSDB_RetirerDuDossier(pnd_Bill, Cstr(v_NoPersAffecterIntial), "A") Then
Call SDSSDB_InfoDossier(Cstr(v_NoPersAffecterIntial),"A" , "", v_AliasVue, "") v_Parametres = Evaluate(|"| & xVar(pnd_Bill, "Bill_NoBillet", "") & |":"| & v_AliasVue & |"|)
Messagebox xGDK_xMessage("SDSS", 26, "", v_Parametres), 48, xGDK_xMessage("SDSS", 18, "", "") Call SIGE_TraiterErreurManuelle(gc_TypeElement_SDSSB, gc_Element_SDSSB, Getthreadinfo(1), 0, _ xGDK_xMessage("SDSS", 26, "", v_Parametres), "", True)
SDSSB_TransfertDossierAffecterEmploye = False Exit Function End If End If
'Ajouter dans dossier de l'employé (transfer de null à employé) If v_NoPersAffecter <> 0 And v_NoPersAffecterIntial = 0 Then
If v_NomGroupeAffecterIntial <> "" Then If Isnull(Arraygetindex(a_NoEmpMembresGroupeInitial, Cstr(v_NoPersAffecter))) Then If Not SDSSDB_AjouterDansDossier(pnd_Bill, Cstr(v_NoPersAffecter), "A") Then
Call SDSSDB_InfoDossier(Cstr(v_NoPersAffecter),"A" , "", v_AliasVue, "") v_Parametres = Evaluate(|"| & xVar(pnd_Bill, "Bill_NoBillet", "") & |":"| & v_AliasVue & |"|)
Messagebox xGDK_xMessage("SDSS", 28, "", v_Parametres), 48, xGDK_xMessage("SDSS", 27, "", "") Call SIGE_TraiterErreurManuelle(gc_TypeElement_SDSSB, gc_Element_SDSSB, Getthreadinfo(1), 0, _ xGDK_xMessage("SDSS", 28, "", v_Parametres), "", True)
SDSSB_TransfertDossierAffecterEmploye = False Exit Function End If End If Else If Not SDSSDB_AjouterDansDossier(pnd_Bill, Cstr(v_NoPersAffecter), "A") Then
Call SDSSDB_InfoDossier(Cstr(v_NoPersAffecter),"A" , "", v_AliasVue, "") v_Parametres = Evaluate(|"| & xVar(pnd_Bill, "Bill_NoBillet", "") & |":"| & v_AliasVue & |"|)
Messagebox xGDK_xMessage("SDSS", 28, "", v_Parametres), 48, xGDK_xMessage("SDSS", 27, "", "") Call SIGE_TraiterErreurManuelle(gc_TypeElement_SDSSB, gc_Element_SDSSB, Getthreadinfo(1), 0, _ xGDK_xMessage("SDSS", 28, "", v_Parametres), "", True)
SDSSB_TransfertDossierAffecterEmploye = False Exit Function End If End If
End If
v_Maj = True End If
'Si affectation précédente = groupe, retirer du groupe (transfer à null) If v_NomGroupeAffecterIntial <> "" Then
If Not SDSSB_RetirerDeDossiersGroupe(pnd_Bill, Cstr(v_NoPersAffecterIntial), a_NoEmpMembresGroupeInitial) Then SDSSB_TransfertDossierAffecterEmploye = False Exit Function End If v_Maj = True End If
If v_Maj = True Then pnd_Bill.Bill_NomGroupeAffecter = "" pnd_Bill.Bill_CodeGroupeAffecter = "" pnd_Bill.Bill_NomGroupeAffecterInitial = "" pnd_Bill.Bill_NoPersAffecterInitial= v_NoPersAffecter Call pnd_Bill.Save(True,False) End If
SDSSB_TransfertDossierAffecterEmploye = True
Exit Function
GererErreur: Call SIGE_TraiterErreur(gc_TypeElement_SDSSB, gc_Element_SDSSB, Getthreadinfo(1), "", False) Exit Function End Function

Function SDSSB_RetirerDeDossiersGroupe(pnd_Bill As NotesDocument, pa_NoEmpMembresGroupe As Variant, pa_NoEmpMembresGroupeInitial As Variant) As Boolean '----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- ' Le script permet de retirer le billet de tous les dossiers des membres du groupe 'Paramètre: ' pnd : NotesDocument. Le billet sélectionné . '----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- On Error Goto GererErreur
'Dim V_Grou40 As notesview Dim v_NomGroupeAffecter As String Dim v_NomGroupeAffecterIntial As String Dim v_NoPersAffecter As Integer Dim v_NoEmpMembresGroupe As Variant Dim v_NoEmpMembresGroupeInitial As Variant Dim nd_GrouAffecter As NotesDocument Dim nd_GrouAffecterInitial As NotesDocument Dim v_AliasVue As String Dim v_Parametres As Variant
' Initialisations '------------------- Call SDSSDB_Initialisations Call xSIEm_Initialisation
v_NomGroupeAffecter = xVar(pnd_Bill,"Bill_NomGroupeAffecter","") v_NomGroupeAffecterIntial = xVar(pnd_Bill,"Bill_NomGroupeAffecterInitial","")
v_NoPersAffecter = xVar(pnd_Bill,"Bill_NoPersAffecter",0)
SDSSB_RetirerDeDossiersGroupe = False
If v_NomGroupeAffecterIntial = "" Or _ v_NomGroupeAffecter = v_NomGroupeAffecterIntial Then Exit Function End If
If Isarray(pa_NoEmpMembresGroupeInitial) Then
' Ne pas retourner de message d'erreur si groupe membres vide If pa_NoEmpMembresGroupeInitial(Lbound(pa_NoEmpMembresGroupeInitial)) = "" Then SDSSB_RetirerDeDossiersGroupe = True Exit Function End If
If pa_NoEmpMembresGroupeInitial(Lbound(pa_NoEmpMembresGroupeInitial)) <> "" Then ' Retirer le billet des anciens dossiers Forall EmpNo In pa_NoEmpMembresGroupeInitial
SDSSB_RetirerDeDossiersGroupe = True
If Isarray(pa_NoEmpMembresGroupe) Then
If Isnull(Arraygetindex(pa_NoEmpMembresGroupe, Cstr(EmpNo))) Then ' Ne pas retiré du dossier si employé dans nouvelle groupe d'affectation If Not SDSSDB_RetirerDuDossier(pnd_Bill, Cstr(EmpNo), "A") Then
Call SDSSDB_InfoDossier(Cstr(EmpNo),"A" , "", v_AliasVue, "") v_Parametres = Evaluate(|"| & xVar(pnd_Bill, "Bill_NoBillet", "") & |":"| & v_AliasVue & |"|)
Messagebox xGDK_xMessage("SDSS", 26, "", v_Parametres), 48, xGDK_xMessage("SDSS", 18, "", "") Call SIGE_TraiterErreurManuelle(gc_TypeElement_SDSSB, gc_Element_SDSSB, Getthreadinfo(1), 0, _ xGDK_xMessage("SDSS", 26, "", v_Parametres), "", True)
SDSSB_RetirerDeDossiersGroupe = False 'Exit Function End If End If
Else 'If Isnull(Arraygetindex(pa_NoEmpMembresGroupeInitial, Cstr(EmpNo))) Then If Cstr(EmpNo) <> Cstr(v_NoPersAffecter) Then If Not Isnull(Arraygetindex(pa_NoEmpMembresGroupeInitial, Cstr(EmpNo))) Then If Not SDSSDB_RetirerDuDossier(pnd_Bill, Cstr(EmpNo), "A") Then
Call SDSSDB_InfoDossier(Cstr(EmpNo),"A" , "", v_AliasVue, "") v_Parametres = Evaluate(|"| & xVar(pnd_Bill, "Bill_NoBillet", "") & |":"| & v_AliasVue & |"|)
Messagebox xGDK_xMessage("SDSS", 26, "", v_Parametres), 48, xGDK_xMessage("SDSS", 18, "", "") Call SIGE_TraiterErreurManuelle(gc_TypeElement_SDSSB, gc_Element_SDSSB, Getthreadinfo(1), 0, _ xGDK_xMessage("SDSS", 26, "", v_Parametres), "", True)
SDSSB_RetirerDeDossiersGroupe = False Exit Function End If End If End If End If
End Forall
End If End If
Exit Function
GererErreur: Call SIGE_TraiterErreur(gc_TypeElement_SDSSB, gc_Element_SDSSB, Getthreadinfo(1), "", False) Exit Function
End Function

Function SDSSB_AssignerAffectation(pnd_Bill As NotesDocument, pnd_Box As NotesDocument, p_Commentaire As String) As Boolean '------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- ' Le script permet d'assigner l'affectation du billet ' ' Paramètres : pnd_Bill ---> Document. Le document duquel provient l'information. '------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- On Error Goto GererErreur
Dim v_NomPersAffecter As String Dim v_NoPersAffecter As Integer Dim v_NoPersAffecterInitial As Integer Dim v_NomGroupeAffecter As String Dim v_NomGroupeAffecterInitial As String Dim v_CodeGroupeAffecter As String
SDSSB_AssignerAffectation = False
v_NoPersAffecterInitial = xVar(pnd_Bill,"Bill_NoPersAffecterInitial",0) v_NomGroupeAffecterInitial = xVar(pnd_Bill,"Bill_NomGroupeAffecterInitial","")
v_NomPersAffecter = xVar(pnd_Box,"DB_NomPersAffecter","") v_NoPersAffecter = xVar(pnd_Box,"DB_NoPersAffecter",0) v_NomGroupeAffecter = xVar(pnd_Box,"DB_NomGroupeAffecter","") v_CodeGroupeAffecter = xVar(pnd_Box,"DB_CodeGroupeAffecter","")
'Assigner le affectation ' ----------------------------- 'Affecter à employé If v_NoPersAffecter <> 0 And v_NomPersAffecter <> "" Then If Not SDSSB_AffecterEmploye(pnd_Bill, v_NomPersAffecter, v_NoPersAffecter, p_Commentaire) Then Exit Function End If 'Affecter à un groupe Elseif v_NomGroupeAffecter <> "" Then If Not SDSSB_AffecterGroupe(pnd_Bill, v_NomGroupeAffecter, v_CodeGroupeAffecter , p_Commentaire) Then Exit Function End If End If
' Affecter à null (retirer l'affectation) If v_NoPersAffecter =0 And v_NomPersAffecter = "" And v_NoPersAffecterInitial <> 0 And v_NomGroupeAffecter = "" Then If Not SDSSB_RetirerAffectationEmploye(pnd_Bill, xVar(pnd_Bill,"Bill_NoPersAffecterInitial",""), p_Commentaire) Then Exit Function End If Elseif v_NomGroupeAffecter = "" And v_NomGroupeAffecterInitial <> "" Then If Not SDSSB_RetirerAffectationGroupe(pnd_Bill, xVar(pnd_Bill,"Bill_NomGroupeAffecterInitial",""), p_Commentaire) Then Exit Function End If End If
SDSSB_AssignerAffectation = True
Exit Function
GererErreur: Call SIGE_TraiterErreur(gc_TypeElement_SDSSB, gc_Element_SDSSB, Getthreadinfo(1), "", False) Exit Function End Function

Function SDSSB_RetirerAffectationEmploye(pnd_Bill As NotesDocument, p_NoPersAffecter As Integer, p_Commentaire As String) As Boolean On Error Goto GererErreur
Dim v_NomPersAffecterInitial As String Dim v_SendTo As Variant Dim v_Commentaire As String
SDSSB_RetirerAffectationEmploye = False
' Initialisations Call SDSSB_Initialisations v_NomPersAffecterInitial = Cstr( xSIEm_xVarEmpl(xVar(pnd_Bill, "Bill_NoPersAffecterInitial",0), "Empl_NomEmploye", "", True)) 'Assigner commentaire v_Commentaire = "Action affectation retiré : " & v_NomPersAffecterInitial If p_Commentaire <> "" Then v_Commentaire = v_Commentaire & Chr(13) & p_Commentaire End If
'Assigner le affectation ' -------------------------------------------------- pnd_Bill.Bill_NoPersAffecter= 0 pnd_Bill.Bill_NomPersAffecter = "" ' RQ 35459 Nveaux champs: Bill_NoSousDepartementAffecter, Bill_DescSousDepartementAffecter pnd_Bill.Bill_NoSousDepartementAffecter = "" pnd_Bill.Bill_DescSousDepartementAffecter = ""
If Not SIHi_Ajouter(pnd_Bill, "", v_Commentaire, "", False) Then Exit Function End If
' Accepter le billet If SIHi_BatirHistorique(pnd_Bill) Then
' Envoyer le courriel aux personnes concernées v_SendTo = Cstr( xSIEm_xVarEmpl(p_NoPersAffecter, "Empl_NotesId", 0, True)) If v_SendTo <> "" Then pnd_BIll.Bill_StatutCommentaires = p_Commentaire
If Instr(Lcase(gndb_SDSSB.Server), "zulu") > 0 Then ' Serveur de développement v_SendTo = gns_SDSSB.UserName End If
Call SICT_EnvoyerCourriel(pnd_Bill, "A_WFBi_R","FR", v_SendTo, "", "", "", False, "")
End If
SDSSB_RetirerAffectationEmploye = True End If
Exit Function
GererErreur: Call SIGE_TraiterErreur(gc_TypeElement_SDSSB, gc_Element_SDSSB, Getthreadinfo(1), "", False) Exit Function End Function

Function SDSSB_AssignerAuteurs(pnd_Bill As NotesDocument) As Boolean %REM Ce script mets les champs d'auteurs dans les "F_Bill". pnd_Bill NotesDocument le document qu'on va ajouter les champs auteurs
"AuteursAdmin" = [Admin] : [Superviseur] "Auteurs" = HistoUC
%END REM On Error Goto GererErreur SDSSB_AssignerAuteurs = False
Dim ni_Auteurs As NotesItem Dim ni_AuteursAdmin As NotesItem Dim v_UserName As String
' Initialisations Call SDSSB_Initialisations
' definir les champs Auteurs Set ni_Auteurs = pnd_Bill.GetFirstItem("Auteurs") If ni_Auteurs Is Nothing Then Set ni_Auteurs = New NotesItem(pnd_Bill, "Auteurs", "") End If Set ni_AuteursAdmin = pnd_Bill.GetFirstItem("AuteursAdmin") If ni_AuteursAdmin Is Nothing Then Set ni_AuteursAdmin = New NotesItem(pnd_Bill, "AuteursAdmin", "") End If
' ajouter le role "Admin" (si necessaire) If Not ni_AuteursAdmin.Contains("[Admin]") Then Call ni_AuteursAdmin.AppendToTextList("[Admin]") End If If Not ni_AuteursAdmin.Contains("[Superviseur]") Then Call ni_AuteursAdmin.AppendToTextList("[Superviseur]") End If
' ajouter le HistoUC (si necessaire) v_UserName = xVar( pnd_Bill, "HistoUC", gns_SDSSB.UserName) If Not ni_Auteurs.Contains(v_UserName) Then Call ni_Auteurs.AppendToTextList(v_UserName) End If
' definir les deux champs comme "Authors" ni_Auteurs.IsAuthors = True ni_AuteursAdmin.IsAuthors = True
SDSSB_AssignerAuteurs = True Exit Function
GererErreur: Call SIGE_TraiterErreur(gc_TypeElement_SDSSB, gc_Element_SDSSB, Getthreadinfo(1), "", False) Exit Function End Function

Function SDSSB_AssignerStatut(pnd_Bill As NotesDocument, p_Statut As String, p_Commentaire As String, p_Rebatir As Boolean) As Boolean On Error Goto GererErreur
Dim v_StatutPrecedent As String Dim v_CleTable As String Dim v_SendTo As Variant
SDSSB_AssignerStatut = False
' Veifier si le statut va changer ' --------------------------------------- If p_Statut = "" Then Exit Function ElseIf p_Statut <> "90" Then If p_Statut = xVar(pnd_Bill, "Bill_Statut", "") Then Exit Function End If End If
' Si statut 90 (complété), demander la cause racine If p_Statut = "90" Then If SDSSB_DemanderCauseRacine(pnd_Bill) = False Then Exit Function End If End If
Call SIGE_AjouterLog("Debut assignation statut", 0, 0, False)
' Initialisations Call SDSSB_Initialisations
v_StatutPrecedent = xVar(pnd_Bill, "Bill_Statut", "")
' Assigner le nouveau statut ' ------------------------------------ v_CleTable = "Bill_Statut" pnd_Bill.Bill_Statut = p_Statut pnd_Bill.Bill_StatutIcone= xIcnTabl(p_Statut, v_CleTable & "FR", True) pnd_Bill.Bill_StatutDesc = p_Statut & " - " & xDescTabl(p_Statut, v_CleTable & "FR", True) pnd_Bill.Bill_StatutDescEN = p_Statut & " - " & xDescTabl(p_Statut, v_CleTable & "EN", True) pnd_Bill.Bill_StatutDate = Now pnd_Bill.Bill_StatutUtilisateur = gns_SDSSB.UserName
'Initialiser les champs Dates pour Export KL #59560 '--------------------------------------------------- If p_Statut >= "10" And p_Statut < "90" Then
pnd_Bill.Bill_KL_DateTransfertOuvert = "" Else 'le statut est >= 90 pnd_Bill.Bill_KL_DateTransfertFerme = ""
End If
' Gérer le workflow ' ------------------------ 'Envoyer un courriel si le statut à changé. Call SIGE_AjouterLog("Envoie courriel assignation statut", 0, 0, False) If p_Statut <> v_StatutPrecedent Then v_SendTo = xVarArray(pnd_Bill,"Bill_MesSuiviID") If Isarray(v_SendTo) Then pnd_BIll.Bill_StatutCommentaires = p_Commentaire
If Instr(Lcase(gndb_SDSSB.Server), "zulu") > 0 Then ' Serveur de développement v_SendTo = gns_SDSSB.UserName End If
Call SICT_EnvoyerCourriel(pnd_Bill, "A_WFBi_S","FR", v_SendTo, "", "", "", False, "")
End If End If
' Ajouter le commentaire à l'historique ' -------------------------------------------------- Call SIGE_AjouterLog("Ajouter le commentaire à l'historique", 0, 0, False) If SIHi_Ajouter(pnd_Bill, p_Statut & " - " & xDescTabl(p_Statut, v_CleTable & "FR", True), _ p_Commentaire, "", p_Rebatir) Then SDSSB_AssignerStatut = True End If
' Mettre le nouveau statut du billet dans la requête ' -------------------------------------------------- Call SIGE_AjouterLog("Ajout statut du billet dans la requête", 0, 0, False) If Not SDSSB_MajRequete(pnd_Bill) Then Print "La maj de la requête (SI Requêtes) avec le statut du billet a échouée" '<EB> End If
Call SIGE_AjouterLog("Fin assignation statut", 0, 0, False) 'Call SIGE_EnregistrerLog Exit Function
GererErreur: Call SIGE_TraiterErreur(gc_TypeElement_SDSSB, gc_Element_SDSSB, Getthreadinfo(1), "", False) Call SIGE_AjouterLog(GetThreadInfo(1), Err(), 119, False) 'Call SIGE_EnregistrerLog Exit Function End Function

Function SDSSB_TransfertDossierAffectation(pnd_Bill As NotesDocument) As Boolean '------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- ' Le script permet de transferer l'affectation du billet ' ' Paramètres : pnd_BCom ---> Document. Le document duquel provient l'information. '------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- On Error Goto GererErreur
SDSSB_TransfertDossierAffectation = False
'Transfert à employé If xVar(pnd_Bill, "Bill_NoPersAffecter", 0) <> 0 And xVar(pnd_Bill, "Bill_NomPersAffecter", "") <> "" Or _ xVar(pnd_Bill, "Bill_NoPersAffecterInitial", 0) <> 0 And xVar(pnd_Bill, "Bill_NomGroupeAffecter", "") = "" Then If Not SDSSB_TransfertDossierAffecterEmploye(pnd_Bill) Then Exit Function End If
'Transfert à un groupe Elseif xVar(pnd_Bill, "Bill_NomGroupeAffecter", "") <> "" Or _ xVar(pnd_Bill, "Bill_NomGroupeAffecterInitial", "") <> "" Then If Not SDSSB_TransfertDossierAffecterGroupe(pnd_Bill) Then Exit Function End If End If
SDSSB_TransfertDossierAffectation = True
Exit Function
GererErreur: Call SIGE_TraiterErreur(gc_TypeElement_SDSSB, gc_Element_SDSSB, Getthreadinfo(1), "", False) Exit Function End Function

Function SDSSB_RetirerAffectationGroupe(pnd_Bill As NotesDocument, p_NomGroupeAffecter As String, p_Commentaire As String) As Boolean On Error Goto GererErreur
Dim v_SendTo As Variant Dim v_Commentaire As String Dim v_MembresSDep As Variant
SDSSB_RetirerAffectationGroupe = False
' Initialisations Call SDSSB_Initialisations Call xSIEm_Initialisation
'Assigner commentaire v_Commentaire = "Action affectation retiré : " & xVar(pnd_Bill, "Bill_CodeGroupeAffecter","") If p_Commentaire <> "" Then v_Commentaire = v_Commentaire & Chr(13) & p_Commentaire End If
'Assigner le affectation ' -------------------------------------------------- 'pnd_Bill.Bill_NomGroupeAffecterInitial = "" pnd_Bill.Bill_NomGroupeAffecter = "" pnd_Bill.Bill_CodeGroupeAffecter = ""
If Not SIHi_Ajouter(pnd_Bill, "", v_Commentaire, "", False) Then Exit Function End If
' Accepter le billet If SIHi_BatirHistorique(pnd_Bill) Then
' Envoyer le courriel au groupe concerné v_MembresSDep = SIEm_MembresSDep_NotesId(p_NomGroupeAffecter)
If Isarray(v_MembresSDep) Then If v_MembresSDep(Lbound(v_MembresSDep)) <> "" Then If Left(Lcase(p_NomGroupeAffecter), 2) <> "sd" Then v_SendTo = "sd" & p_NomGroupeAffecter End If Else v_SendTo = p_NomGroupeAffecter End If Else v_SendTo = p_NomGroupeAffecter End If
If v_SendTo <> "" Then pnd_BIll.Bill_StatutCommentaires = p_Commentaire
If Instr(Lcase(gndb_SDSSB.Server), "zulu") > 0 Then ' Serveur de développement v_SendTo = gns_SDSSB.UserName End If
Call SICT_EnvoyerCourriel(pnd_Bill, "A_WFBi_R","FR", v_SendTo, "", "", "", False, "")
End If
SDSSB_RetirerAffectationGroupe = True End If
Exit Function
GererErreur: Call SIGE_TraiterErreur(gc_TypeElement_SDSSB, gc_Element_SDSSB, Getthreadinfo(1), "", False) Exit Function End Function

Function SDSSB_TransfertDossierConseiller(pnd_Bill As NotesDocument) As Boolean '------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- ' Le script permet de transferer le billet au conseiller sélectionné. '------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- On Error Goto GererErreur
Dim v_NoConseiller As Integer Dim v_NoConseillerIntial As Integer Dim v_Maj As Boolean
SDSSB_TransfertDossierConseiller = False
'Maj des dossiers du conseiller si le conseiller à changé. v_NoConseiller = xVar(pnd_Bill,"Bill_NoConseiller",0) v_NoConseillerIntial = xVar(pnd_Bill,"Bill_NoConseillerInitial",0)
If v_NoConseiller = 0 Or v_NoConseillerIntial = v_NoConseiller Then SDSSB_TransfertDossierConseiller = True Exit Function End If
If v_NoConseillerIntial <> v_NoConseiller Then ' Transfert de dossier If Not SDSSB_TransfertDeDossierEmploye(pnd_Bill, v_NoConseiller, v_NoConseillerIntial, "C") Then SDSSB_TransfertDossierConseiller = False Exit Function End If v_Maj = True End If
If v_Maj = True Then pnd_Bill.Bill_NoConseillerInitial = Cint(v_NoConseiller) Call pnd_Bill.Save(True,False) End If
SDSSB_TransfertDossierConseiller = True
Exit Function
GererErreur: Call SIGE_TraiterErreur(gc_TypeElement_SDSSB, gc_Element_SDSSB, Getthreadinfo(1), "", False) Exit Function End Function

Function SDSSB_AssignerConseiller(pnd_Bill As NotesDocument, pnd_Emp As NotesDocument) As Boolean '------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- ' Le script permet de transferer le billet au conseiller sélectionné. ' ' Paramètres : pnd_Bill ---> Document. Le document duquel provient l'information. ' pnd_Emp ---> Document. Le document du nouveau conseiller '------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- On Error Goto GererErreur
SDSSB_AssignerConseiller = False
'si selectionne le même conseiller ne met pas a jour le document If xVar(pnd_Bill, "Bill_NoConseiller", 0) = xVar(pnd_Emp, "Empl_NoEmploye", 0) Then Exit Function End If
' Ajouter le # d'employé pnd_Bill.Bill_NoConseillerInitial=xVar(pnd_Bill, "Bill_NoConseiller", 0) pnd_Bill.Bill_NoConseiller = xVar(pnd_Emp, "Empl_NoEmploye", 0)
SDSSB_AssignerConseiller = True

Function SDSSB_MajRequete(pnd_Bill As NotesDocument) As Boolean '------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- ' Ce script met à jour la requête avec le statut du billet ' ' Paramètre: ' pnd_Bill: document du billet '------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- On Error Goto GererErreur
Dim nd_Requ As NotesDocument
Dim a_NoRequetes As Variant Dim pl_ListeItemsBillet List As Variant Dim v_NoBillet As Long Dim i As Integer
' Initialisation ' -------------- SDSSB_MajRequete = False Call xSIRq_Initialisation Call SIAT_Initialisations
' Mettre le statut du billet dans la requête ' ------------------------------------------ v_NoBillet = xVar(pnd_Bill, "Bill_NoBillet", 0)
' Extraire la (les) requête(s) du billet a_NoRequetes = Evaluate(|@DbLookup("" : "NoCache"; "| & gndb_xSIRq.Server & |" : "| & Replace(gndb_xSIRq.FilePath, "\", "\\") & _ |"; "V_Requ25"; "| & v_NoBillet & |"; 2; [FailSilent])|)
If a_NoRequetes(0) <> "" Then ' Lire les champs du Billet pl_ListeItemsBillet("Bill_Statut") = xVar(pnd_Bill, "Bill_Statut", "") pl_ListeItemsBillet("Bill_StatutIcone") = xVar(pnd_Bill, "Bill_StatutIcone", 0) pl_ListeItemsBillet("Bill_StatutDesc") = xVar(pnd_Bill, "Bill_StatutDesc", "")
For i = 0 To Ubound(a_NoRequetes) ' Extraire la requête Set nd_Requ = xSIRq_xndRequ(a_NoRequetes(i), True) If xVarElem(nd_Requ, "Requ_NoBillet", 0, "") = v_NoBillet Then ' Appel à l'agent qui fera la mise à jour de la requête (pour éviter les conflits) Call SIAT_MajDocument(nd_Requ, pl_ListeItemsBillet) SDSSB_MajRequete = True End If Next End If
Exit Function
GererErreur: Call SIGE_TraiterErreur(gc_TypeElement_SDSSB, gc_Element_SDSSB, Getthreadinfo(1), "", False) Exit Function End Function

Sub Click(Source As Button) Dim nuiws As New NotesUIWorkspace Dim ns As New NotesSession Dim ndb As NotesDatabase Dim ndc As NotesDocumentCollection Dim nd_Prof As NotesDocument Dim nd As NotesDocument Dim i As Integer Dim v_Langue As String
Dim v_NbMaj As Long
Set ndb = ns.CurrentDatabase Set ndc = ndb.UnprocessedDocuments If ndc.Count = 0 Then Messagebox "Aucun document sélectionné.", 16, "Opération annulée" Exit Sub End If
Set nd_Prof = ndb.GetProfileDocument("F_SonP01") Set nd = ndc.GetFirstDocument Do Until nd Is Nothing If xvar(nd, "Sond_Annee", "") = "" Then v_Langue = xVar(nd, "Sond_Langue", "FR") nd.Sond_Annee = xVar(nd_Prof, "Prof_Annee", "") For i = 1 To 6 v_Description = xVar(nd_Prof, "Prof_Jour" & Cstr(i) & "_Libelle" & v_Langue, "") Call nd.ReplaceItemValue("Sond_DescJour" & Cstr(i), v_Description) If v_Description <> "" Then Call nd.ReplaceItemValue("Sond_AbbreviationJour" & Cstr(i), xVar(nd_Prof, "Prof_Jour" & Cstr(i) & "_Abbreviation", "")) Else Call nd.ReplaceItemValue("Sond_AbbreviationJour" & Cstr(i), "") End If Next Call nd.Save(True, False) v_NbMaj = v_NbMaj + 1 End If
Set nd = ndc.GetNextDocument(nd) Loop
If v_NbMaj > 0 Then Call nuiws.ViewRefresh End If Print "Fin de la correction " & Cstr(v_NbMaj) & "/" & Cstr(ndc.Count) End Sub
Option Public Option Declare Use "SDSS_DossierBillets" Use "SI_GestionErreurs" Use "SI_Extractions" Use "x_GDK" Use "x_SIEm"

Dim gns_A As NotesSession Dim gndb_A As NotesDatabase
' Traitement des erreurs ' ----------------------------------- Const gc_TypeElement_A = "A" Const gc_Element_A= "A_MajDG"

Sub Initialize '---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- 'Cet agent schedulé met à jour les dossiers des membres des groupes en affectation. '---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- On Error Goto GererErreur
Dim v_Grou20 As NotesView Dim v_SIEmGrou40 As NotesView Dim v_Bill22 As NotesView Dim nd As NotesDocument Dim nd_Suivant As NotesDocument Dim v_NomGroupeAffecter As String Dim ndc As NotesDocumentCollection Dim nd_SIEmGrouAffecter As NotesDocument Dim v_NoEmpMembresGroupe As Variant Dim nd_Bill As NotesDocument Dim nd_BillSuivant As NotesDocument
' Initialisations Call A_Initialisations Call xSIEm_Initialisation
Set v_Grou20 = gndb_A.GetView("v_Grou20") Set v_SIEmGrou40 = gndb_xSIEm.GetView("v_Grou40") Set v_Bill22 = gndb_A.GetView("v_Bill22")
Set nd = v_Grou20.GetFirstDocument
' Boucler les billets ouvert par groupe ' ------------------------------------------------- Set nd_Suivant = v_Grou20.GetFirstDocument
Do Until nd_Suivant Is Nothing Set nd = nd_Suivant Set nd_Suivant = v_Grou20.GetnextDocument(nd_Suivant) v_NomGroupeAffecter = xVar(nd, "Grou_GroupeAffe", "") Set ndc = v_Bill22.GetAllDocumentsByKey(v_NomGroupeAffecter, True)
If ndc.Count > 0 Then ' Maj les dossiers des membres des groupes en affectation ' ------------------------------------------------------------------------------- If Not v_SIEmGrou40 Is Nothing Then Set nd_SIEmGrouAffecter = v_SIEmGrou40.GetDocumentByKey(v_NomGroupeAffecter, True) If Not nd_SIEmGrouAffecter Is Nothing Then v_NoEmpMembresGroupe = SDSSDB_ExtraireMembresGroupe(nd_SIEmGrouAffecter, v_NomGroupeAffecter) End If
Set nd_BillSuivant = ndc.GetFirstDocument Do Until nd_BillSuivant Is Nothing Set nd_Bill = nd_BillSuivant Set nd_BillSuivant = ndc.GetnextDocument(nd_BillSuivant) If Isarray(v_NoEmpMembresGroupe) Then If v_NoEmpMembresGroupe(Lbound(v_NoEmpMembresGroupe)) <> "" Then ' Ajouter les billets dans les dossiers Forall EmpNo In v_NoEmpMembresGroupe If Not SDSSDB_AjouterDansDossier(nd_Bill, Cstr(EmpNo), "A") Then Exit Sub End If End Forall End If End If Loop End If End If
Loop
Exit Sub GererErreur: Call SIGE_TraiterErreur(gc_TypeElement_A, gc_Element_A, Getthreadinfo(1), "", False) Exit Sub End Sub
Sub A_Initialisations If gns_A Is Nothing Then Set gns_A = New NotesSession Set gndb_A = gns_A.CurrentDatabase End If End Sub

'si selectionne le même suivi par ne met pas a jour le document If xVar(gnd_Affec, "DB_NoPersAffecter", 0) = xVar( nd_Emp, "Empl_NoEmploye", 0) Then Exit Sub End If
